achievements.title: TITLE: RVITM Achievements | Awards, Rankings & Success
achievements.snippet: • RVITM Achievements | Awards, Rankings & Success • ## Recognising Excellence ## Achievements ## INSTITUTIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS • 2024 ## Sambhram 2026 Sambhram 2026, RVITM's inter college cultural extravaganza, was celebrated on 23rd and 24th April 2026. The festivities for Sambhram 2026, started with a pre event. The stage for the main was adorned by Actor and Big Boss Kannada 11 star, Mr. Dharma Keerthiraj, This year’s edition, themed “Roots and Rhythms”, celebrated the evolution of art and cultural expression across the ages.300 plus registrations spanning across several colleges and events was a record at RVITM. The festival featured over 26 diverse events, including performing arts, literary competitions, fine arts and digital showcases—providing a vibrant platform for students to exhibit their talents and engage with peers from institutions across the region. Our annual cultural Newsletter Kalaamayaa, showcasing the happenings of the Cultural Club, was also released on this occasion. It also showcased the gorgeous talent of our own RVITM students, by way of their performances for the Inauguration event. The event also saw the grand concert performance by SWAR Academic · 2024 ## Sports Achievements Technical · 2025 ## Technical Achievements Cultural · 2025 ## Clutural ## DEPARTMENT ACHIEVEMENTS Each department at RVITM contributes to the academic and technological advancement of the institution.

departments__library-2.title: TITLE: RVITM Digital Library | Learning Resources
departments__library-2.snippet: • RVITM Digital Library | Learning Resources • Library and Information Centre The RVITM library is a hybrid library and a hub of knowledge. The library is the liveliest place on the campus, with a friendly and pleasant environment. It encourages and extends learning and research assistance. It has a rich collection of books, journals, magazines, online databases and other academic resources. The library is the backbone of academic and research activities and facilitates access to a huge number of e-resources and other academic resources through various online databases. Trained and committed library staff are at the service of the academic community to support with the relevant information. All the library functions are fully automated using the LIBSOFT Library Management System and enabled with RFID for surveillance and circulation operations. It is connected with high-speed internet and Wi-Fi with multimedia systems to access various licensed and open-access electronic resources in all subject areas. ## My Account LOGIN ## Library Working Hours ## The library will be kept open from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on all working days. ## Borrowing Parameters The following are the categories of borrowing facility for different user group subject to the fulfilment of conditions noted below. • LIBRARY Services ## Circulation The library follows an Open Access System. One can pick any book of their choice from the shelves and may refer to or borrow it. ## Reference The library has a good collection of reference books. The reference books are meant to be used within the library and cannot be borrowed.

nss.title: TITLE: NSS -
nss.snippet: • NSS - • ## National Service Scheme (NSS) Empowering students to contribute to society through service , leadership and community engagement . Join NSS at RVITM Explore NSS Activities ## ABOUT NSS The National Service Scheme (NSS) is a government-sponsored programme that aims to develop students' personalities and character through voluntary community service. At RVITM , the NSS unit provides students with opportunities to engage in meaningful social initiatives that benefit society while fostering leadership, teamwork, and civic responsibility. Through various outreach programmes, students gain a deeper understanding of social challenges and learn to contribute positively to their communities. ## Motto The Motto of NSS, “Not Me But You”, reflects the essence of democratic living and upholds the need for selfless service. NSS helps students develop an appreciation for another person’s point of view and shows consideration for other living beings. The philosophy of the NSS is well documented in this motto, which underlines the belief that the welfare of an individual is ultimately dependent on the welfare of society as a whole; therefore, NSS volunteers shall strive for the well-being of society. ## OBJECTIVES OF NSS The NSS programme focuses on developing socially responsible citizens through active community participation. ## Key Objectives •
